beginner.summary: For developers who can write Python or TypeScript and are new to the Claude API. Covers the Console and API keys, the Messages API with curl and the Python and TypeScript SDKs, system prompts, sampling and stop reasons, tokens and counting, model tier selection (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku), streaming, errors and retries, rate limits, cost, image and PDF inputs, tool use, structured JSON, key safety, a small evaluation set and a ticket triage capstone.
prerequisites: Writes working programs in Python or TypeScript and uses pip or npm
Uses a terminal, curl and JSON comfortably
Has an Anthropic Console account with a funded API key and permission to install packages
outcomes: Call the Messages API reliably from curl, Python and TypeScript with correct headers, retries and error handling
Choose model tiers and control tokens, streaming, rate-limit behaviour and cost
Build tool-using, JSON-producing assistants that accept text, images and PDFs
Evaluate a prompt against a test set and ship a small triage service with a runbook

advanced.summary: For senior engineers and architects running Claude systems in production. Covers the Claude Agent SDK, permissions and hooks, custom tools, subagents, skills and CLAUDE.md, orchestration patterns, Claude on Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI, multi-provider failover, computer use, interleaved thinking, cost and latency engineering, capacity management, safety architecture, privacy, statistical evaluation, model migration and incident response, ending with a production agent platform capstone.

Knows containers, IAM on AWS or Google Cloud and CI pipelines
Can read logs and metrics in Prometheus or Grafana
outcomes: Design and secure agents with the Agent SDK, hooks, subagents and skills
Run Claude across Anthropic, Bedrock and Vertex AI with failover and consistent controls
Engineer cost, latency, capacity and safety to measurable targets
Operate with statistical evaluation gates, safe migrations and incident runbooks
